items.Sentence: The treatment plant process consists of Aeration Ponds 1 and 2 which have aerators and can be operated individually in parallel or together in series with a detention time of five or more days in each aeration pond.

After aeration, wastewater flows to Settling Ponds 1, 2, and 3 which are operated in parallel with a detention time of one or more days. One settling pond can alternatively be used for sludge storage when not being used for settling operations.
The County of San Luis Obispo plans to install a manual bar screen and must include details about system upgrades in their annual report.
Disinfection includes a chlorine contact channel with a design detention time of 60-minutes. The chlorination system uses 20-25 gpd 12.5% sodium hypochlorite for disinfection.
Effluent Pump Two pumps with 180,000 gpd capacity each. Treated, disinfected secondary-23 effluent is discharged to Effluent Storage and a blending pond...

Treated, disinfected secondary-23 effluent is discharged to Effluent Storage and a blending pond that is owned and operated by the San Luis Obispo Golf and Country Club for use in the golf course irrigation system.
The Country Club Estates blends the recycled water supplied by the County of San Luis Obispo with well water and uses it for irrigation.
Obispo County Ordinance 2597 banned the use of water softening systems or devices which cause high concentration of salts to be discharged into the public sewer at CSA-18.
Solids accumulate at the bottom of the settling ponds and are removed 1 to 2 times per year depending on sludge judge measurements.
